design_rules.parent_carries_tag: A subtotal row's tag is hoisted onto the container it totals. A total is never a sibling of its own inputs.
design_rules.tree_is_the_calculation_graph: derivation.inputs == the tags of a node's child concepts. Presentation groups (headers with no total row) are transparent to this.
design_rules.rolls_up_to_determines_placement: Q3Redirection (sheet col 8) says which parent an unnumbered row feeds. Those rows are NESTED under that parent, so the invariant holds.
design_rules.classified_as_is_not_a_roll_up: redirection DatasetNo-2 (col 7) maps a tag into another dataset (EXINTOI -> INTOI = 'interest income shown as exceptional'). It is the SAME money reported once; summing it would double-count.
design_rules.signed_weights: '1 minus 2' and the income/expense split are subtractions. inputs may be {tag, weight}.
design_rules.not_considered_is_metadata: It is a value of the redirection column meaning 'no counterpart in that dataset' -- NOT an exclusion from sums. All of section 8 is NOT CONSIDERED yet is part of PBTR.
design_rules.three_kinds_of_formula: derivation = COMPOSITION (inputs are this node's children; the invariant applies). waterfall = a running-total step whose inputs are PEER nodes earlier in the statement (RFONET = 1 minus 2; PBMI = 11 plus 13) -- the invariant does NOT apply. reconciliation = a REPORTED value checked against a formula of either kind.
design_rules.reported_wins: A parent that the report prints keeps the reported value; the sum of children is a CHECK, not a replacement. This is what lets TCS's DEPEXP=4,288 stand while DEP/AMT are null.

fields.definition: Total income-tax charge: current plus deferred, including prior-year adjustments. Excludes indirect taxes.

The current-tax SUBTOTAL as the filer reports it. Most filers already fold prior-year adjustments into this figure -- TCS prints 16,124 less a 1,946 prior-year benefit and reports 14,178 -- so take the subtotal, not its parts.
Tax effect of temporary differences. Often a credit (negative) when reversing.

ONLY a tax charge the filer presents SEPARATELY FROM and IN ADDITION TO its current- and deferred-tax lines, such that current + deferred + this equals the reported total tax expense. If the reported total already equals current + deferred, there is no other tax and this is a correct null.
fields.measured: On TCS this was filled with -1,566 taken from the EFFECTIVE-TAX-RATE RECONCILIATION ('Income exempt from tax'), a table that explains why expected tax differs from reported tax rather than composing it. Total tax expense then came out at 12,144 against a reported 13,710. TCS's total is exactly current 14,178 + deferred (468); nothing else belongs in it.
